en.name: Bombadil
en.ability: Once per game, at dusk, you may silence all players, look at the Grimoire, publicly point at a player, and then leave.

en.flavor:
Hey dol! merry dol! ring a dong dillo!
Ring a dong! hop along! fal lal the willow!
Tom Bom, jolly Tom, Tom Bombadillo!
